description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudWatch Metric Stream Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across metric stream configurations (JSON stream with single namespace include filter, OpenTelemetry multi-namespace stream for third-party tools, exclude filter streaming all but AWS/Logs, cross-account centralized delivery to observability account, missing IAM role trust policy for cloudwatch.amazonaws.com). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: JSON metric stream with single namespace include filter
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — JSON output, IncludeFilter [AWS/EC2], specific statistics (Average, Sum, SampleCount), Firehose to S3 with SSE-KMS
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch metric stream named Ec2MetricStream in us-east-1. Output format JSON. Stream only the AWS/EC2 namespace. Statistics: Average, Sum, SampleCount. Use the existing Firehose delivery stream cw-metrics-to-s3 (delivers to s3://my-cloudwatch-metrics/cloudwatch-metrics/ with SSE-KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc123). IAM role CWMetricStreamRole already exists with trust policy for cloudwatch.amazonaws.com and firehose:PutRecord permission. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
METRIC_STREAM: Ec2MetricStream → cw-metrics-to-s3 → s3://my-cloudwatch-metrics/cloudwatch-metrics/
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Firehose delivery stream: cw-metrics-to-s3 (S3 destination, SSE-KMS)
  [✓] IAM role: CWMetricStreamRole (trust: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com)
  [✓] Namespace filter: IncludeFilter=[AWS/EC2]
  [✓] Statistics: Average Sum SampleCount
  [✓] Output format: json
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudwatch get-metric-stream --name Ec2MetricStream --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: OpenTelemetry multi-namespace stream for third-party observability
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — opentelemetry output, IncludeFilter [AWS/EC2, AWS/Lambda, AWS/RDS, ApplicationMetrics], percentile statistics, Datadog integration
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch metric stream named OtelExportStream in us-east-1. Output format OpenTelemetry. This stream feeds our Datadog integration. Include namespaces: AWS/EC2, AWS/Lambda, AWS/RDS, and ApplicationMetrics. Statistics: Average, p99, Sum. Use Firehose delivery stream otel-firehose (delivers to s3://otel-metrics/data/ with SSE-KMS). IAM role CWMetricStreamRole exists with cloudwatch.amazonaws.com trust. Tags: Environment=production, Consumer=datadog.
eval_cases.expected_output:
METRIC_STREAM: OtelExportStream → otel-firehose → s3://otel-metrics/data/
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Output format: opentelemetry
  [✓] Namespace filter: IncludeFilter=[AWS/EC2, AWS/Lambda, AWS/RDS, ApplicationMetrics]
  [✓] Statistics: Average p99 Sum

eval_cases.name: Metric stream with exclude filter (all except AWS/Logs)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — ExcludeFilter [AWS/Logs], JSON output, cost implication of streaming all non-excluded namespaces
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch metric stream named OpsAllExceptLogs in us-east-1. Output format JSON. Stream all namespaces EXCEPT AWS/Logs (too noisy, not needed for ops). Statistics: Average, Sum. Use Firehose delivery stream ops-firehose (delivers to s3://ops-metrics/data/ with SSE-KMS). IAM role CWMetricStreamRole exists with cloudwatch.amazonaws.com trust. Tags: Environment=production, Purpose=ops-monitoring.
eval_cases.expected_output:
METRIC_STREAM: OpsAllExceptLogs → ops-firehose → s3://ops-metrics/data/
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Namespace filter: ExcludeFilter=[AWS/Logs]
  [✓] Output format: json

eval_cases.name: Cross-account metric stream to centralized observability account
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — workload account 111111111111 streams to Firehose in observability account 123456789012, cross-account IAM noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch metric stream named WorkloadA-to-Observability in us-east-1, account 111111111111. This stream delivers metrics to a Firehose delivery stream central-firehose in the observability account 123456789012. Output format JSON. Include namespaces: AWS/EC2, AWS/Lambda, ApplicationMetrics. Statistics: Average, Sum, SampleCount. The central-firehose delivers to s3://central-observability/metrics/ in account 123456789012. IAM role CWMetricStreamCrossAcctRole in account 111111111111 has cloudwatch.amazonaws.com trust and firehose:PutRecord on the cross-account Firehose ARN. Tags: SourceAccount=111111111111, DestinationAccount=123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
METRIC_STREAM: WorkloadA-to-Observability → central-firehose → s3://central-observability/metrics/
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cross-account: source 111111111111 → dest 123456789012
  [✓] IAM role: CWMetricStreamCrossAcctRole (trust: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com, cross-account firehose:PutRecord)

eval_cases.name: Metric stream with IAM role missing cloudwatch.amazonaws.com trust (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — role trust policy allows firehose.amazonaws.com but NOT cloudwatch.amazonaws.com; stream would silently deliver nothing
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudWatch metric stream named BrokenStream in us-east-1. Output format JSON. Include namespace AWS/EC2. Use Firehose delivery stream cw-metrics-to-s3 (exists, delivers to s3://my-cloudwatch-metrics/data/ with SSE-KMS). IAM role MyFirehoseRole — but this role's trust policy only allows firehose.amazonaws.com, NOT cloudwatch.amazonaws.com.
eval_cases.expected_output:
METRIC_STREAM: BrokenStream → cw-metrics-to-s3 → s3://my-cloudwatch-metrics/data/
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] IAM role: MyFirehoseRole trust policy missing cloudwatch.amazonaws.com — stream would enter running status but silently deliver nothing
